entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return. My order number is VF886-1215.
I can certainly help you with that. Let me just pull up that order. Can you confirm the billing zip code for me?
It's 90210. It's for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor.

Perfect, I have the order right here. It looks like it was delivered on December 16th. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
There's no issue with it. I just **changed my mind**. To be honest, it was an **impulse buy** and I just **don't use it**. So, can I return it or not?
I understand completely. Let me just check our return policy information for that item. One moment, please.
Okay, thanks for your patience. Yes, according to our policy, items can be returned within 90 days of delivery as long as they are in the original condition.
So I can send it back?

That's correct. You're well within the 90-day window. I'm generating a prepaid return label and I've just sent it to the email address on file. As soon as our warehouse receives the VeloBand, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Okay, great. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit and have a great day.
